name_zh: 软件出口/安蒂尔/数字国家：通才整合与农牧科技融合
name_en: Software Exports/Antil/Digital Nation: Polymath Integration & Agri-Tech Fusion
description_zh: 乌拉圭软件产业 1990s 起步/安蒂尔(Alan Etchebarne/Guillermo Talenta) 等先驱/人均软件出口拉美第一/Plan Ceibal(一孩一机)/电子政府/区块链/金融科技/视频游戏/农牧科技(追踪/基因/精准畜牧)。核心模式：农牧+科技融合 — 传统优势产业(牛肉/羊毛/大米/大豆)与数字创新(区块链溯源/基因编辑/精准农业/农业金融科技)深度融合。体现 M158 通才整合/农牧+科技 — 以"软件出口领跑+一孩一机普惠+农牧科技融合+电子政府透明"四位一体，在小国/人口老龄化/资源依赖三重约束下实现数字跃迁。
description_en: Uruguay software industry 1990s start/Antil (Alan Etchebarne/Guillermo Talenta) pioneers/per capita software exports LatAm #1/Plan Ceibal (one laptop per child)/e-government/blockchain/fintech/video games/agri-tech (traceability/genomics/precision livestock). Core model: agri-tech fusion — traditional competitive industries (beef/wool/rice/soy) deeply fused with digital innovation (blockchain traceability/genomics/precision ag/agri-fintech). Exemplifies M158 Polymath Integration/Agri-Tech — quaternity of 'software exports leader + one laptop per child inclusion + agri-tech fusion + e-government transparency' achieving digital leap amid triple constraints of small nation/aging population/resource dependency.
reason_zh: 乌拉圭数字化非单纯产业升级，而是"软件出口+普惠教育+农牧融合"三位一体国家战略。以 Plan Ceibal 普及数字素养，以软件出口创造高薪就业，以农牧科技升级传统优势。M158 区隔于 M158 通才整合(核心)、M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)、M174 社会实验室(巴特列)，核心在于"软件即新出口引擎+教育即数字公民+农牧即传统优势数字化"的小国数字跃迁范式。
reason_en: Uruguay digitalization not mere industrial upgrade but 'software exports + inclusive education + agri-tech fusion' trinity national strategy. Plan Ceibal universalized digital literacy, software exports created high-wage jobs, agri-tech upgraded traditional strengths. M158 distinct from M158 Polymath Integration (core), M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), M174 Social Laboratory (Batlle), core: 'software as new export engine + education as digital citizenship + agri-tech as traditional strength digitalization' small nation digital leap paradigm.
